columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Replayable agent memory needs execution-time eligibility evidence, not similarity alone
columns.title_zh: 可重放 Agent Memory 需要执行时资格证据，不能只靠相似度命中
columns.source_zh: EchoPath 一手研究：把经过 Artifact 校验的 GUI 轨迹转化为带参数、状态前置条件和歧义拒绝机制的可调用 Memory
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260917-005 after Skill 02 triage. EchoPath exposes a bounded long-horizon Digital Employee problem: a previously successful trajectory should not become executable merely because a future task looks semantically similar. The primary research binds replay to trajectory provenance, declared parameters, execution-time state preconditions and rejection/repair when target resolution is uncertain. The research question is therefore what evidence makes remembered work eligible to execute again, and how replay should fail closed when the current environment no longer matches the recorded conditions. This is distinct from the September 13 AgentRewind object, which studied coordinated rollback of context and environment after an error; today's object studies admission of a learned successful trajectory as a future callable action before replay begins.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260917-005。EchoPath 暴露了一个边界清晰的长周期数字员工问题：一条过去成功的 Trajectory 不能仅因为未来任务在语义上相似，就自动获得再次执行的资格。该一手研究把 Replay 与 Trajectory Provenance、声明参数、执行时 State Preconditions 绑定，并在目标解析存在歧义时拒绝重放或转入 Repair。研究问题因此收敛为：记住的工作在再次执行前必须证明哪些 Eligibility Evidence，以及当当前环境不再满足历史条件时 Replay 应如何 Fail Closed。它与 9 月 13 日 AgentRewind 对象不同：后者研究错误发生后如何协调回滚 Context 与 Environment；今天研究的是一条历史成功轨迹在未来被当作 Callable Action 之前，如何获得 Replay Admission。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify EchoPath's memory-extraction pipeline, artifact validation, parameterization rules, state-precondition representation, visual target re-aiming, ambiguity/rejection path, repair or replanning fallback, benchmarks, baselines, ablations, replay success/failure cases, provenance preservation and limits outside GUI environments. It must separate replay eligibility from business authorization, idempotency and exactly-once external effects.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 EchoPath 的 Memory Extraction Pipeline、Artifact Validation、参数化规则、State-precondition 表示、Visual Target Re-aiming、歧义/拒绝路径、Repair 或 Replanning Fallback、Benchmark、Baseline、Ablation、Replay 成败案例、Provenance Preservation，以及 GUI 环境之外的局限；必须把 Replay Eligibility 与 Business Authorization、Idempotency、Exactly-once External Effect 分开。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Threat detection is not containment when adversarial state can persist and propagate across agents
columns.title_zh: 当对抗状态可跨 Agent 持久传播时，Threat Detection 不等于 Containment
columns.source_zh: Emergence World 一手研究：在长周期多 Agent 系统积累真实运行状态后注入受控对抗事件，并追踪后续 Memory、跨 Agent 传播与行为影响
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260917-006 as the strongest Industry Architecture object. Emergence World studies persistent multi-agent systems after operational state has accumulated and reports a separation between threat recognition and later system containment: adversarial content can enter memory, propagate through ordinary coordination surfaces and influence behavior long after the initial event. The bounded architecture question is what quarantine, propagation-boundary and recovery evidence must exist once harmful state has crossed from an observed message into durable shared or per-agent state. This extends but does not duplicate the September 7 authority-to-effect security object: that work asked whether an end-to-end authority/effect path is closed; today's object isolates temporal persistence and cross-agent contamination after detection has already succeeded.
columns.reason_zh: 作为本日 Industry Architecture 中最强的一手 Research Object，选自 SIG-20260917-006。Emergence World 在多 Agent 系统已经积累运行状态后再注入受控对抗事件，并报告 Threat Recognition 与后续 System Containment 之间存在明显分离：恶意内容可以进入 Memory，经普通协作界面继续传播，并在初始事件之后很久仍影响行为。边界清晰的架构问题是：当有害状态已经从一条被观察到的消息进入 Durable Shared State 或 Per-agent State 后，系统需要什么 Quarantine、Propagation Boundary 与 Recovery Evidence。它延伸但不重复 9 月 7 日的 Authority-to-effect Security 对象：后者研究端到端 Authority/Effect Path 是否闭合；今天单独研究“已经检测成功之后”的时间持久性与跨 Agent 污染。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify Emergence World's environment and agent population, long-horizon state accumulation, adversarial-event injection protocol, detection metrics, memory writes, cross-agent propagation paths, the reported persistence horizon, behavioral effects, system-composition comparisons, containment or recovery interventions, baselines, negative cases and external-validity limits. It must not infer universal production compromise from benchmark persistence alone.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Emergence World 的 Environment 与 Agent Population、长周期 State Accumulation、Adversarial-event Injection Protocol、Detection Metric、Memory Write、Cross-agent Propagation Path、报告的 Persistence Horizon、Behavioral Effect、System-composition Comparison、Containment/Recovery Intervention、Baseline、Negative Case 与 External-validity Boundary；不得仅由 Benchmark 中的持久性推导所有生产系统都会被攻破。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260917-002, SIG-20260917-003 and SIG-20260917-004 each expose concrete merged engineering mechanisms around bounded session provenance, human-confirmation state continuity and request-time OAuth scope challenges. All three are useful candidates, but each currently rests primarily on a single maintainer implementation. Under Skill 02's evidence-sufficiency and source-concentration rules, none is promoted solely because it is a fresh merged change, especially when two same-date primary-research objects already provide stronger independent evidence. They remain candidates for future cross-sample comparison.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260917-002、SIG-20260917-003 与 SIG-20260917-004 分别提供了 Bounded Session Provenance、Human-confirmation State Continuity 与 Request-time OAuth Scope Challenge 三个具体的 Merged Engineering Mechanism，均具有研究价值；但当前每个对象仍主要依赖单一 Maintainer Implementation。按照 Skill 02 的 Evidence Sufficiency 与 Source Concentration 规则，不能仅因为它们是最新合入变更就提升为正式 Research Object，尤其今天已有两个证据更强的一手研究对象。因此三者保留为 Candidate，等待未来跨样本比较。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260917-002, SIG-20260917-003 and SIG-20260917-004 as candidates for future studies of causal provenance across handoff, approval-state materialization and call-time least-privilege authorization. Reading must perform no separate Open-source Engineering Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260917-002、SIG-20260917-003 与 SIG-20260917-004 为 Candidate，等待未来围绕 Handoff 中的 Causal Provenance、Approval-state Materialization 与 Call-time Least-privilege Authorization 开展跨样本研究；本轮 Reading 不得为 Open-source Engineering 单独执行 Deep Reading。
